items.title: One Stack, Full VCF: Deploying VMware Cloud Foundation 9 on Amazon EVS with the EVS Deployment Orchestrator
items.summary: Earlier this year we walked through deploying VCF 9 on Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) using a phased automation workflow. Since then, we’ve improved and streamlined that automation into the EVS Deployment Orchestrator (EDO), now available in the solutions-for-amazon-evs repository. EDO is a tool that automates an end-to-end VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9.x deployment […]
items.creator: David Piet, Ph.D.
